title: Composition series of a Weil representation
statement:
Let $V$ be the finite-dimensional Weil representation in the
monodromy data of a lisse Weil sheaf.
A *composition series* is a finite filtration by Weil-stable
subspaces

$$
0=V_0\subsetneq V_1\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq V_t=V
$$

such that every quotient $V_i/V_{i-1}$ is a *simple Weil
representation*: it is nonzero and has no nonzero proper Weil-stable
subspace. These
quotients, with repetitions retained, are the *composition factors*
of the chosen series.

lean.note: The published representation-theory module already defines the canonical composition-series structure and its factor abbreviation. Its series field is a finite RelSeries of Weil-stable subrepresentations with head 0 and last V; each adjacent step is a cover, and the recorded isIrreducible_factor theorem identifies the successive quotients as nonzero simple Weil representations. The structure is stated generically for representations, so it applies to the finite-dimensional Weil representation supplied by the monodromy datum without introducing a second definition.
